title.zh: C08 P-XL 关键团战反打，14:13 逆转 Player5 夺冠
title.en: C08 P-XL rallies to beat Player5 14-13 in dramatic 4-way clash

desc.zh: Player5 前期一路领跑，C08 P-XL 在 300 回合后通过连续精准护送打出反击高潮，在终场前反超 1 分绝杀夺冠。
desc.en: Player5 led through turn 300 before C08 P-XL mounted a surgical late-game rally, stealing victory in the closing stretch.
